responsibility: Defines the `AstConv` interface and the core AST-to-`ty` conversion logic for this module, coordinating path/type/region/generic-argument lowering, recording converted types, validating late-bound region usage, and deriving object lifetime bounds used by sibling helpers.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is the shared conversion layer that defines the `AstConv` trait and implements HIR/AST-to-`ty` lowering primitives such as inference placeholders, associated-item projection setup, normalization hooks, and object-lifetime-bound derivation; the others are analysis or checking entry points built on top of those converted types.
